title: Inbox triage pocket journal
content:
Morning snapshot (2026-03-13) - quick capture

- Mood: wired but focused. coffee + 20m inbox triage.
- Key win yesterday: prelim perf numbers for small-batch quant heuristic looked reasonable (latency +3ms median, cost -9%). need peer review.

Top 5 items (today) - rapid-fire
1) PRD edit: reduce ambiguity in 'failover routing' section — clarify sequence when model variant not available. (block: wording; ask SRE)
2) Stakeholder touchpoints: 10:30 sync w/ Infra (Jordan) re: Dedicated capacity slots; 14:00 ops-biz cadence w/ Maya.
3) Runbook draft for canary rollback - make checklist actionable, <8 steps.
4) Launch checklist gating items: metric alerts, docs link, customer notify copy.
5) Follow up on GH PR #312: address test flakiness + add one new e2e for KV cache warm path.

PRD edits - freeform notes
- Section: Routing & Fallbacks (line 72-89) -> rewrite so order is: region affinity -> model variant -> lower-tier fallback -> retry w/backoff. Add small diagram? ascii ok in doc.
- Behavioral spec for SDK errors: 400 for client input issues, 503 for capacity throttling (include Retry-After header guidance).
- Acceptance criteria: add explicit latency SLOs per route (p95 < 150ms for chat_small, p95 < 300ms for chat_long). tie to alert names.
- Open question: do we automatically degrade sampling temp for fallback variants? Pros/cons listed below.

Stakeholder follow-ups (action items)
- Jordan (infra) - confirm Dedicated capacity shard count needed for initial pilot by EOD Wed. (ticket INFR-2451)
- Maya (solutions eng) - draft customer-facing preflight email by Tue; include KB link + troubleshooting blurb.
- Legal (cc): need short blurb about data residency for Private deploy; add link in Console settings UI copy.
- SRE: who is oncall for Canary weekends? add to runbook and page.

Launch checklist (working - not final)
- Product: PRD final + signoff (ops, infra, legal) -> owner: Avery
- Runtime: model artifacts verified; quant profile tagged -> owner: Applied ML
- Observability: dashboards created, test alert firing (simulate) -> owner: Observability
- Docs: quickstart + preflight steps published -> owner: DevRel
- Ops: rollback playbook + canary policy pushed -> owner: SRE
- Comms: customer group notified (template draft) -> owner: Maya
- Billing: confirm metering + usage tags for Dedicated -> owner: Finance eng

Notes to self - quick bits
- Shorten the PRD intro; too much background narrative. Keep it scannable: problem, proposal, tradeoffs, acceptance.
- Insert mini-table in doc for model variants mapping to fallback behavior.
- Flag: add note to Console UX: show "expected latencies" per model so customers can pick.
- Keep a small appendix for testers: how to run local KV-warm benchmark.

Parking lot / unresolved
- How to present partial tokens in streaming fallback? UX decision. Ask design.
- Decide SLA language for Dedicated pilot (trial customers vs paid). Legal review required.
- Should we automatically disable prefix caching for models >1M params? probably not; need empirical.

Quick links / tickets to look at
- INFR-2451 (capacity plan)
- DOCS-987 (quickstart draft)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/312 (PR: KV cache test)
- CONFLUENCE-PLAT-4267 (canary rollback runbook)

Evening checklist (what to update before I log off)
- Push PRD changes to branch and drop link in ticket.
- Confirm Jordan's number for capacity and update INFR ticket.
- Draft the comms subject line for pilot customers: "Redwood Dedicated pilot: next steps & preflight"

Lingering micro-things (tiny TODOs)
- add a line in PRD about metric tags (route, model, quant_profile) - important for cost attribution.
- quick sanity check on the e2e flake: reproduce locally with --seed=42.
- remind Maya to include known limitations in template (no on-prem for pilot).

Timestamped micro-journal (for trace)
- 09:15: triage email -> moved 12 threads to folders, left 4 flagged.
- 09:45: quick sync with Eng leads -> aligned on failover ordering.
- 10:20: left note on GH PR for flake -> need repro steps.

Random capture (brain-dump)
- Idea: small "latency simulator" in Console for customers to approximate perceived latency by choosing region, model, token-length. Useful sales demo.
- Consider a small metric: "percent of requests returned via fallback" and show trend line in Console. Add to acceptance.

End of pocket journal - will clean and port key bits to PRD and tickets later tonight.

- avery
